glossary.definition: (1) "Peace officer" has the same meaning as in section 2921.51 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2907.10 - Preliminary polygraph test of sex offense victim.

glossary.definition: (2) "Polygraph examination" means any mechanical or electrical instrument or device of any type used or allegedly used to examine, test, or question an individual for the purpose of determining the individual's truthfulness.
glossary.source_title: Section 2907.10 - Preliminary polygraph test of sex offense victim.

glossary.definition: (3) "Prosecution" means the prosecution of criminal charges in a criminal prosecution or the prosecution of a delinquent child complaint in a delinquency proceeding.
glossary.source_title: Section 2907.10 - Preliminary polygraph test of sex offense victim.

glossary.definition: (4) "Prosecutor" has the same meaning as in section 2935.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2907.10 - Preliminary polygraph test of sex offense victim.

glossary.definition: (5) "Public official" has the same meaning as in section 117.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2907.10 - Preliminary polygraph test of sex offense victim.

glossary.definition: (6) "Sex offense" means a violation of any provision of sections 2907.02 to 2907.09 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2907.10 - Preliminary polygraph test of sex offense victim.

glossary.definition:
(7) "Alleged juvenile offender" has the same meaning as in section 2930.01 of the Revised Code.
